name: zingo-ffi
description: The wallet backend's UniFFI surface, bound to React Native by uniffi-bindgen-react-native.
author: Zingo Labs

scripts.ubrn:generate: (cd ../../rust/lib && ubrn generate jsi bindings --library --ts-dir ../../packages/zingo-ffi/src/generated --cpp-dir ../../packages/zingo-ffi/cpp/generated ../target/release/libzingo.dylib) && ubrn generate jsi turbo-module --config ubrn.config.yaml zingo && prettier --write src
